title: Woman & Little Girl, 1949 Vintage Black & White Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Απριλίου 1949
Εδώ είμαι εγώ
καί ένα κοριτσάκι
τῆς γειτονειᾶς μου
Σᾶς φιλῶ,
Αργυρώ
Argiro Sksnelo
1949
description: A black and white snapshot from April 1949 featuring an elegantly dressed woman holding hands with a young girl outside a home. The woman wears a mid-length collared dress with buttons and a thin belt, while the girl wears a checked dress with pigtails. The handwritten Greek inscription on the reverse side roughly translates to: 'April 1949 / Here I am and a little girl from my neighborhood / Sending kisses, Argiro'.
